chunks: But the more I called, they only ran the farther away.
ai.seo_question: How did Noah's people respond to his continuous calls to faith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the psychological depth of the disbelievers' rejection, where Noah’s (peace be upon him) persistent supplication (du'a) did not soften their hearts but rather intensified their aversion, revealing a state of spiritual stubbornness (istidraj). This reflects the principle that divine invitation requires receptivity, and persistent preaching to the obstinate may lead to further entrenchment in disbelief. The verse serves as a lesson for believers on the limits of human persuasion and the necessity of divine will in guiding hearts.
